performance_engine: NautilusTrader 1.230.0 via existing candidate-02 v53 run_window path

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of eligible Monday weeks within the already locked feature coverage after excluding all previously revealed candidate-02 weeks

causal_question: When persistent aggressive order flow reaches an external auction boundary, did it create accepted price discovery, become absorbed while new inventory accumulated, or exhaust forced liquidation inventory?
state_machine: freeze the prior completed 60-minute auction before the impact window
measure the completed 15-minute aggressive-flow direction, price response and impact efficiency
classify inventory from causal OI change and toxicity from causal VPIN
require an external frozen-boundary sweep or close acceptance
wait for the first completed one-minute boundary reclaim or hold/retest
submit a NautilusTrader bracket on the next one-minute bar
invalidate beyond the observed sweep or back inside the accepted boundary
target the opposite frozen boundary for rotations or a measured auction extension for accepted discovery

mutually_exclusive_modes.cause: aggressive flow and rising OI produce inefficient price impact at an external boundary, indicating passive absorption of new positions
mutually_exclusive_modes.direction: opposite the failed impact after the first causal one-minute reclaim
mutually_exclusive_modes.target: opposite side of the frozen prior auction

mutually_exclusive_modes.cause: toxic aggressive flow and material OI decline sweep an external boundary, indicating forced inventory liquidation that can exhaust
mutually_exclusive_modes.direction: opposite the liquidation impulse after the first causal one-minute reclaim
mutually_exclusive_modes.target: opposite side of the frozen prior auction

mutually_exclusive_modes.cause: aggressive flow, rising OI and efficient price impact close beyond a frozen boundary without extreme toxicity
mutually_exclusive_modes.direction: with the accepted impact after the first causal one-minute boundary hold/retest

promotion_rule: Only a mode satisfying every first-week gate may be frozen unchanged before a fresh second BTC week is selected and collected. A mode failing because of sparse signals, negative direction quality, poor reward geometry or excessive drawdown is not promoted.
